xwikidoc.title: 登录/登出审计日志
xwikidoc.content:
{{velocity}} == 登录/登出审计日志 ==
(% class="xform" %) * **说明**：记录登录成功、登录失败与主动登出；仅保留最近 100 条，每页显示 20 条。
#set ($enabledValue = "$!xcontext.getWiki().Param('xwiki.authentication.audit-log.enabled')") #set ($enabled = ($enabledValue == '' || $enabledValue == '1')) #if (!$enabled) {{warning}}审计日志功能已关闭（`xwiki.authentication.audit-log.enabled=0`）。{{/warning}} #else #set ($pageSize = 20) #set ($page = 1) #set ($pageParam = "$!request.getParameter('page')") #if ($pageParam.matches('\\d+')) #set ($page = $numbertool.toNumber($pageParam).intValue()) #end #set ($all = $services.query.xwql('from doc.object(AuditLog.LogRecordClass) as record order by doc.creationDate desc').execute()) #set ($total = $all.size()) #set ($maxPage = 1) #if ($total > 0) #set ($maxPage = (($total + $pageSize - 1) / $pageSize)) #end #if ($page > $maxPage) #set ($page = $maxPage) #end #if (1 > $page) #set ($page = 1) #end #set ($fromIndex = ($page - 1) * $pageSize) #set ($toIndex = $fromIndex + $pageSize) #if ($toIndex > $total) #set ($toIndex = $total) #end
#if ($total == 0) {{info}}暂无审计记录。{{/info}} #else |=时间|=用户|=事件|=渠道|=IP|=详情 #foreach ($name in $all.subList($fromIndex, $toIndex)) #set ($recordDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($name)) #set ($recordObj = $recordDoc.getObject('AuditLog.LogRecordClass')) #if ($recordObj) #set ($eventType = "$!recordObj.getValue('eventType')") #set ($channel = "$!recordObj.getValue('channel')") #set ($eventName = '') #if ($eventType == 'LOGIN_SUCCESS') #set ($eventName = '登录成功') #end #if ($eventType == 'LOGIN_FAILURE') #set ($eventName = '登录失败') #end #if ($eventType == 'LOGOUT') #set ($eventName = '登出') #end #set ($channelName = '—') #if ($channel == 'OA') #set ($channelName = 'OA') #end #if ($channel == 'ZHIXI') #set ($channelName = '知悉') #end #if ($channel == 'FORM') #set ($channelName = '表单') #end #if ($channel == 'BASIC') #set ($channelName = '基本认证') #end |$!recordObj.getValue('eventTime')|$!recordObj.getValue('userName')|$eventName|$channelName|$!recordObj.getValue('ip')|$!recordObj.getValue('detail') #end #end #end
== 分页 == (% class="xform" %)共 $total 条 / $maxPage 页 #if ($page > 1) #set ($prevPage = $page - 1) #set ($prevUrl = $doc.getURL('view', "page=$prevPage")) [[上一页>>$prevUrl]] #end #if ($maxPage > $page) #set ($nextPage = $page + 1) #set ($nextUrl = $doc.getURL('view', "page=$nextPage")) [[下一页>>$nextUrl]] #end #end {{/velocity}}
